title_human: Level-2 p-adic Apéry system for ζ(5)

claims.statement: L_5 = Sym^4(L_2) where L_2=θ²+4t(4θ+1)² and L_5 = θ⁵+8t(2θ+1)(8θ⁴+16θ³+17θ²+9θ+2)+4096t²(θ+1)⁵
Φ(τ) = E_6(τ) - E_6(2τ) = A·D_t (exact modular identity)

d_n^5 B_n^* ∈ Z for n≥0, but d_3^4 B_3^* ∉ Z, so arithmetic denominator weight five is sharp
